name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd
title: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd - 532720 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mahindra Finance Q4 PAT up 55% and FY26 ROA 2.0%, but a Rs 217 cr macro overlay (about 1.5% credit cost in Q4 vs 0.9% ex-overlay) and a 12% AUM growth cap the quality of the beat.

triggers.label: Fee & other income 1.1% → 1.4% of assets
triggers.quote: 1.1% last year fee and other income has moved to 1.4%. So that's a good and this is not onetime, we do believe this will stay.
triggers.highlight: this is not onetime, we do believe this will stay

triggers.label: NIM +60 bps for FY26
triggers.quote: which has given us an overall NIM expansion of 101 bps YoY and for the full year 60 bps increase in NIM.
triggers.highlight: for the full year 60 bps increase in NIM

triggers.label: Rs 217 cr macro overlay on book
triggers.quote: the management overlay that we have created in Q4 in rupee value is INR 217 crores.

triggers.label: Growth 16-18% CAGR medium term
triggers.quote: yes 16% to 18% is the CAGR growth for the medium term.

guidance.quote: our business model should factor or stomach 1.3 to 1.7. We are confident to stay within that.
